query:
# Russian given names of Wikidata: an item that is a male or a female given name (P31) and has a Russian label.
# CC0 data; `wikidata.py` runs this query and writes the snapshot — the only step that needs the network.
# P282 («writing system») is NOT asked: the Russian-labelled items of Мария, Елена, Феодосия, Агриппина, Фёкла
# are Latin-script ones. Cyrillic-ness is checked on the label in `wikidata.py`.
# The public endpoint cuts a query at 60 s and this class is too big for one: `wikidata.py` runs the query once
# per range of item numbers, @LO@ <= number < @HI@ (and splits a range in two when the endpoint cuts it), so the
# file is one query, parametrised. The links come from `links.sparql`, so they do not multiply these rows.
SELECT ?item ?label ?class
WHERE {
  VALUES ?class { wd:Q12308941 wd:Q11879590 }
  ?item wdt:P31 ?class .
  FILTER(xsd:integer(STRAFTER(STR(?item), "/entity/Q")) >= @LO@ && xsd:integer(STRAFTER(STR(?item), "/entity/Q")) < @HI@)
  ?item rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(LANG(?label) = "ru")
}
